sources.title: Pupil size reveals arousal level fluctuations in human sleep
sources.authors: Manuel Carro-Domínguez, Stephanie Huwiler, Stella Oberlin, Timona Leandra Oesch, Gabriela Badii, Anita Lüthi, Nicole Wenderoth, Sarah Nadine Meissner, Caroline Lustenberger
sources.sample: 18 recruited healthy adults (1 excluded for OSDI dry-eye score > 12), 17 included (10 female, 7 male; mean age 29.83 +/- 8.69 years; BMI 17-30; CHF 70 compensation); n = 15 met >=44.61% valid eye-tracker frame threshold (mean 75.69 +/- 5.66% over 4h).
sources.key_findings: First continuous overnight infrared pupillometry paired with human polysomnography. Pupil-to-iris ratio dropped from wake through N1/N2 to equally low minima in N3 and REM (F(4, 57.43)=168.90, p<0.001) and tracked Fpz 30-45 Hz EEG spectral slope (R(4264)=0.34, p<0.001). In N2, pupil diameter oscillated infraslowly out of phase (~108 deg, 30% cycle) with 12-16 Hz sigma spindle power (R=-0.26, p<0.001). Pupil size constricted -11.51 +/- 1.46% before spindle trains, dilated +13.49 +/- 2.21% after K-complexes, and dilated +35.37 +/- 9.88% after arousals. During 45 dB pink-noise tones, verum dilated pupils early (+13.77 +/- 4.81%, p=0.046) and late (+34.87 +/- 12.90%, p=0.046) vs sham; auditory spindle boosting (+5.53 +/- 2.04 uV^2 sigma, p=0.044; +928.67 +/- 381.79 uV^2 delta, p=0.031) occurred only when baseline pupils were small, vanishing when pupils were large (+0.08 +/- 2.17 uV^2 sigma, p=0.97).
sources.limitations: Small lab cohort (17 included, 15 in continuous pupil sleep-architecture stats, 8 pupil / 10 EEG in V1 auditory stimulation); right eyelid was taped open under a protective shield with vitamin A ointment for the first 4h in total darkness (2/17 recalled brief waking); human locus coeruleus activity is inferred indirectly via non-luminance pupil dynamics rather than invasive unit recordings.

sources.title: An electrophysiological marker of arousal level in humans
sources.authors: Janna D. Lendner, Randolph F. Helfrich, Bryce A. Mander, Luis Romundstad, Jack J. Lin, Matthew P. Walker, Pal G. Larsson, Robert T. Knight
sources.key_findings: Established the 30-45 Hz aperiodic EEG spectral slope (1/f exponent) as a reliable electrophysiological index separating wake, NREM, and REM arousal levels in humans, directly linked to Carro-Domínguez et al. pupil dynamics (R=0.34).

sources.title: Pupil diameter covaries with BOLD activity in human locus coeruleus
sources.authors: Peter R. Murphy, Redmond G. O'Connell, Michael O'Sullivan, Ian H. Robertson, Joshua H. Balsters
sources.key_findings: Concurrent 3T fMRI and pupillometry in healthy humans demonstrated that spontaneous and task-evoked pupil size variations selectively covary with BOLD signal in the dorsal pontine locus coeruleus.

sources.title: Relationships between Pupil Diameter and Neuronal Activity in the Locus Coeruleus, Colliculi, and Cingulate Cortex
sources.authors: Siddhartha Joshi, Yin Li, Rishi M. Kalwani, Joshua I. Gold
sources.key_findings: Single-unit neurophysiology proved that spikes in brainstem locus coeruleus neurons tightly precede and drive pupil dilation transients across spontaneous and evoked arousal states.

sources.title: Spontaneous brain rhythms predict sleep stability in the face of noise
sources.authors: Thien Thanh Dang-Vu, Scott M. McKinney, Orfeu M. Buxton, Jo M. Solet, Jeffrey M. Ellenbogen
sources.key_findings: Behavioral polysomnography experiment showing people who generate higher spontaneous 12-16 Hz sleep spindle rates sleep stably through overnight environmental sounds, explaining why spindle-rich thalamus gating protects sleep.

sources.title: Effects of auditory sleep modulation approaches on slow waves and autonomic recovery functions
sources.authors: Stephanie Huwiler, Manuel Carro-Domínguez, Walter Karlen, Christian R. Baumann, Nicole Wenderoth, Caroline Lustenberger
sources.key_findings: Tested phase-locked 45 dB pink-noise auditory stimulation during NREM sleep in humans and showed sound stimulation boosts slow waves and parasympathetic autonomic balance depending on brain state.

sources.title: The locus coeruleus in aging
sources.key_findings: Review synthesis linking tonic and phasic locus coeruleus norepinephrine bursts in the brainstem to sleep stability, cortical excitability, cognitive reserve, and autonomic regulation across the adult lifespan.

sources.title: Dynamic modulation of decision biases by brainstem arousal systems
sources.authors: Jan Willem de Gee, Olympia Colizoli, Niels A. Kloosterman, Tomas Knapen, Sander Nieuwenhuis, Tobias H. Donner
sources.key_findings: Demonstrated in humans that rapid pupil dilations reflect phasic brainstem arousal recruitment across noradrenergic and cholinergic nuclei that dynamically shift cortical responsiveness.

followups_replications_critiques.title: An electrophysiological marker of arousal level in humans
followups_replications_critiques.note: Independent EEG spectral-slope validation across human wake, NREM, and REM states.

followups_replications_critiques.title: Spontaneous brain rhythms predict sleep stability in the face of noise
followups_replications_critiques.note: Behavioral replication showing sleep spindle rhythm shields human sleepers against ambient sound.
